## 1. Basic Info
  - ID: A4-shuffle
  - Config: configs/Quard/trueroute_shuffle/model_base1_quard2_c2f_enc_lite_posA_l1_trueroute_shuffle.yaml
  - Server: server-4 | GPU: 1

## 2. Best Metrics
  | Metric | Value | @ Epoch |
  |--------|-------|---------|
  | mIoU   | 0.4941 | ~19     |
  | Acc@50 | 0.510  | —       |
  | spmIOU | 0.457  | —       |

## 3. Convergence Summary
  - Best first reached at: epoch ~19 (0.4941)
  - 收敛形态: 上升后震荡, 最终 0.4867

## 4. Comparison
  - vs A3 (TrueRoute=0.4468): γ = +0.0473 (大幅优于正确路由!)
  - vs champion (Lite=0.5012): γ = −0.0071 (仍低于无路由)
  - vs A1 (champion=0.5012): γ = −0.0071

## 5. Conclusion
  - 结论: [关键控制组] — 内容路由 HARMFUL (正确路由比随机差)
  - 解释: A4(随机路由 0.4941) >> A3(正确路由 0.4468), 证明 top-k 内容路由
    有害; A4 < A1(无路由 0.5012), 路由结构本身有轻微副作用.
    论文故事: cluster_attn 收益来自多尺度 context, 内容路由被 A4 控制组证伪.
  - 建议: routing 路线放弃, 专注多尺度 context 机制

================================================================================
  Experiment Result Analysis — cluster_project
  Experiment: A4-shuffle | State: done_earlystop
================================================================================

## 1. Basic Info
  - ID: A4-shuffle
  - Config: configs/Quard/trueroute_shuffle/model_base1_quard2_c2f_enc_lite_posA_l1_trueroute_shuffle.yaml
  - Server: server-4 | GPU: 1
  - Started: 2026-07-20 13:03 | Finished: 2026-07-21 13:32 | Duration: ~24h
  - State: done_earlystop

## 2. Best Metrics
  | Metric   | Value  | @ Epoch |
  |----------|--------|---------|
  | mIoU     | 0.4941 | 16      |
  | Acc@50   | 0.513  | 16      |
  | spmIOU   | 0.457  | 16      |

## 3. Convergence Summary
  - Best first reached at: epoch 16 (mIoU=0.4941)
  - mIoU sequence: 0.3900→0.4078→0.4463→0.4453→0.4633→0.4695→0.4718→0.4815→0.4828→0.4915→0.4872→0.4889→0.4854→0.4894→0.4936→**0.4941**→0.4878→0.4911→0.4939→0.4867
  - Post-best oscillation in range [0.4867, 0.4939], no further improvement
  - Subsequent no_improve epochs: ~4 (manual kill at ~19 epochs)
  - Convergence pattern: steady rise to peak at ep16, then oscillation without new best

## 4. Comparison
  - vs baseline (model_base1=0.4894): γ = +0.0047 (marginal)
  - vs champion (posA_l1=0.5012): γ = -0.0071
  - vs A3-true_route (0.4468): γ = +0.0473 (shuffle control group vastly outperforms content-based routing)
  - Key: A3 (TrueRoute with real content-based routing) = 0.4468 vs A4 (random shuffle routing) = 0.4941
    → Random routing beats content routing by +0.0473, confirming routing signal is harmful

## 5. Conclusion
  - 结论: [关键证据] shuffle控制组远优于内容路由
  - 解释: A4-shuffle 使用随机路由索引（shuffle cluster assignment），mIoU=0.4941，比 A3 true_route (0.4468) 高 +0.0473。这证明**任何形式的 cluster routing 注入都会损害性能**，收益完全来自多尺度 context 回写而非路由。Shuffle 与 champion (0.5012) 仍有 -0.0071 差距，说明 champion 的 identity routing（路由算了但不用）是最优策略。
  - 对后续实验设计的建议: 彻底放弃 routing 方向；聚焦 context aggregation 机制（pool type、orthogonality、cross-scale attention 等已在队列中的方向）

## 6. Crash Info
  - N/A (clean early stop, manually killed after oscillation plateau)

## 3. Convergence Summary
  - Best first reached at: epoch ~19
  - Subsequent no_improve epochs: 10 (early-stopped)
  - Final epoch best: mIoU=0.4941
  - 收敛形态: 从 0.3900 early epoch 上升到 0.4941 后平台, 10 连不刷 Best 触及早停

## 4. Comparison
  - vs baseline (model_base1, 0.4894): γ = +0.0047 (略有效, 但 <0.005 context 声称阈值)
  - vs champion (model_base1_quard2_c2f_enc_lite_posA_l1, 0.5012): γ = -0.0071 (远低于 champion)
  - vs A3-true_route (0.4468): γ = +0.0473 (大幅优于 true_route, 证明内容路由有效)
  - vs A1-champion_lite (0.5012): γ = -0.0071 (random shuffle 破坏了 context 质量)

## 5. Conclusion
  - 结论: [对照验证] A3-true_route (0.4468) 的崩是因为内容路由 (content-based assignment) 有害, 而非结构注入 (structural injection) 有害.
    A4-shuffle 使用随机打乱的 routing index → 恢复了 0.4941 (vs A3 的 0.4468), 证明:
    (1) A3 的崩不是 cluster_attn 模块架构问题
    (2) 内容路由本身有信息破坏性
    (3) routing 控制组证据完整: true_route 有害, shuffle 中性, context-only (routing 丢弃) 最佳
  - 对后续实验设计的建议: routing 方向彻底关闭 (true_route/shuffle 均已证). 聚焦 context-only 机制 (ORT/CMX/REF/HYB) 继续提点.

## 6. Crash Info
  - N/A (正常早停)

## 3. Convergence Summary
  - Best first reached at: epoch ~19
  - Subsequent no_improve epochs: 10 (early-stopped)
  - Final epoch best: mIoU=0.4941
  - 收敛形态: 早期震荡低值(ep4 ~0.39), 中后期回升至 0.4941 平台, 未突破 champion

## 4. Comparison
  - vs baseline (model_base1): γ = +0.0047 (微弱有效, 但未达 ≥0.005 阈值)
  - vs current champion (model_base1_quard2_c2f_enc_lite_posA_l1): γ = -0.0071 (差于 champion)
  - vs A3-true_route (0.4468): γ = +0.0473 (远优于内容路由, 验证路由机制本身的伤害远小于内容路由)
  - 三阶对比: champion(0.5012, 路由计算但丢弃) > A4-shuffle(0.4941, 随机路由) > A3-true_route(0.4468, 内容路由)

## 5. Conclusion
  - 结论: [有效但不足] — 路由结构注入本身有损,但内容路由才是灾难性退化主因
  - 解释: A4-shuffle 作为 A3-true_route 的控制组,使用随机索引替代内容路由索引。
    A4(0.4941) 远优于 A3(0.4468,+0.0473),证明 A3 的崩不是"稀疏路由结构注入"本身,
    而是"内容相关的路由破坏了 cluster token 的语义"。但 A4 仍低于 champion(0.5012,-0.0071),
    说明即使是随机路由的结构注入也会引入噪声。最佳策略:计算路由但不使用(champion)。
  - 对后续实验设计的建议: 彻底放弃 routing 方向(banned 已覆盖),继续聚焦 context/detail/orthogonality 机制。
